name: Why is mold prevention part of flood damage restoration?

mainEntity.name: Why is mold prevention part of flood damage restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold thrives in damp environments and can begin to grow within 24 to 48 hours of water exposure. Preventing mold growth is a critical component of flood damage restoration because mold can cause significant health issues and further structural damage. Our restoration process includes thorough drying, dehumidification, and application of antimicrobial treatments to inhibit mold formation, ensuring a healthy and safe environment after water damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold prevention is crucial because mold grows rapidly in damp conditions, causing health issues and further damage; restoration includes drying and antimicrobial treatments.
